name: National Federation of Independent Business et al. v. Sebelius, Secretary of Health and Human Services, et al.; and Florida et al. v. Department of Health and Human Services et al.
name_abbreviation: National Federation of Independent Business v. Sebelius

court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

parties: National Federation of Independent Business et al. v. Sebelius, Secretary of Health and Human Services, et al.; and Florida et al. v. Department of Health and Human Services et al.

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 1033.] H. Bartow Farr III, Esq., of Washington, D. C., is invited to brief and argue these cases as amicus curiae in support of the judgment of the Court of Appeals that the minimum coverage provision of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, 26 U. S. C. § 5000A, is severable from the entirety of the remainder of the Act.
